responsibility: Portable document numbering: the format, reset and scope a numbered field declares, the storage-neutral allocator port and its one refusal.
non_responsibilities: Any allocator implementation: the counter store, its transaction, its locks and fencing, deadlock retry and unique constraints stay in the host.
Business numbering policy: which documents are numbered, what an invoice or stock number is, and when a run may be repaired are the host's and its extensions'.
A fiscal calendar: a fiscal-period key is a posting period the host declared; this package only renders the key it is handed.
Site and organization authority: the record scope a counter is keyed by is resolved and enforced by the host.
Container registration: values, enums, the port and the refusal are constructed directly; the host binds its adapter to the port identifier and there is no provider.
Real-database evidence, which the host proves on the engines it supports.

capabilities.title: Number format declaration and rendering
capabilities.description: Read a numbered field's declaration into a validated value with a closed grammar and fixed bounds, name the counter it draws from, and render an allocated value deterministically.

capabilities.title: Reset period vocabulary and period keys
capabilities.description: The calendar boundary a run restarts at, and the period key an instant maps to in the declared zone; the fiscal-period case defers to the host's declared posting periods.

capabilities.title: Tenancy scope vocabulary and scope keys
capabilities.description: The tenancy boundary a run is unique and contiguous within, and the closed scope-key grammar that keeps one tenant out of another's counter.

capabilities.title: Allocator port and its one refusal
capabilities.description: The storage-neutral port that reserves the next value of one counter inside the caller's transaction with a gapless-on-commit promise, and the one canonical refusal an allocation answers with; the package ships no implementation of the port.
